lab09-s000.title: Before You Begin
lab09-s000.markdown:
**Estimated time:** 45–60 minutes (excluding data preparation)
**What you will build:** A comparison Warehouse, Lakehouse Delta tables, an Ontology Preview defining Product / Period / Revenue Observation, and a read-only Fabric Data Agent referencing the Ontology.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Scope of hands-on verification:** Parts 3–5 were verified in Fabric using the included synthetic CSV. Verification covered COPY into the Warehouse and numerical checks, Lakehouse Delta tables, Ontology bindings / Graph materialization, and some Data Agent questions. This was not an end-to-end verification including extraction from a real Plan / writeback in Parts 1–2. Do not confuse the sample route with the real-Plan route.
>
> The synthetic CSV used in the steps is the public `data/lab09-variance-snapshot-sample.csv`. It is not actual Fabric data or customer data. The Data Agent remains in Draft and was not published / shared. Execution images document UI operations, but do not generalize capabilities or causes beyond what they show.

lab09-s001.title: 1. Purpose and Verification Boundary
lab09-s001.markdown:
Compare Lab04's *Gross Revenue* and *Forecast* by **Product × month**, give the variances meaning through an Ontology, and ask read-only questions of a Fabric Data Agent. This does not automatically write back to the Plan or original semantic model.

The Lab04 Plan uses *Gross Revenue* and *Forecast*, with Product Category / Sub Category on rows and Year / Quarter / Month Short on columns. Do not assume that regional or Gross Profit plan values already exist. Sample FY26 values are workshop fixtures, not real-world FY26 actuals.

| Route | Scope | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Synthetic sample route** | Upload the included CSV to a Lakehouse, then try Part 3 Warehouse / Spark SQL, Part 4 Ontology, and Part 5 Data Agent | Parts 3–5 verified hands-on with this synthetic CSV. This does not verify extraction from a real Plan or production data |

lab09-s002.title: Verified Scope
lab09-s002.markdown:
- **Verified:** Copied 18 synthetic CSV rows into Warehouse Stage and passed count / key / value checks. Created Lakehouse Delta tables with 6 Product rows, 3 Period rows, and 18 Revenue Observation rows. Projected Ontology entity types / relationship types into the Graph and confirmed materialization of 3 entity types and 2 relationship types. Data Agent Q1 / Q3 / Q4c in the table below matched expected values.
- **Verification limitation:** `nodes 3 / edges 2` is a configuration display indicating 3 Ontology entity types / 2 relationship types. It is not a verified count of data instances, including the 18 Observations, or evidence of graph edge traversal.



- **Recorded failures:** Q4 / Q4a returned `SQLCandidatesFailedFilterError`. Do not conclude that all questions specifying multiple months fail, and do not present these failures as successes.

lab09-s003.title: Fabric / AI
lab09-s003.markdown:
- Data Agent requires paid F2 or higher, or P1 or higher with Fabric enabled. Meeting Planning trial conditions alone does not necessarily make Data Agent available. Review capacity, OneLake, and Warehouse billing with the administrator.
- The tenant administrator must review Copilot / Azure OpenAI use and cross-geo processing / storage settings against organizational policy. Do not change these settings yourself.
- Ontology is in Preview. Check tenant settings, regional availability, and creation permissions in advance. Screens and features change over time.
- Data Agent reads sources using the user's own permissions. It cannot change, approve, or write back to a Plan. Separate permissions are also required to create / edit the Ontology and its bindings.
- Even when rerunning with synthetic data, use dedicated new exercise items and stop if existing items are found. Do not overwrite existing tables with `DROP`, `TRUNCATE`, `DELETE`, or `CREATE OR REPLACE`. The Spark `CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE` shown here records a verification performed on dedicated new tables; it is not a published procedure for existing tables.
- Do not include tenant IDs, account names, tokens, credentials, or customer data in prompts, public logs, images, or CSVs. Also check retention and audit conditions for Data Agent conversations / data processing with the administrator.

lab09-s004.title: Data Routes
lab09-s004.markdown:
- **Synthetic sample route:** Skip Parts 1–2 and use the included `data/lab09-variance-snapshot-sample.csv`. Its values are synthetic. This route reproduces the UI operations demonstrated in Parts 3–5.

> [!WARNING]
> On a real-Plan route in Fabric, do not modify target Plan / writeback tables or existing values. Perform impactful operations, including tenant AI settings, permissions, item creation, capacity consumption, and file uploads, only after administrator approval. Captures in this document are masked and do not contain personal information or similar details. When capturing evidence in a real environment, inspect personal names, workspace identifiers, URLs, and IDs before sharing.

lab09-s005.title: 3. Data Contract
lab09-s005.markdown:
The comparison CSV uses the 15 columns in [`data/lab09-variance-snapshot-template.csv`](../data/lab09-variance-snapshot-template.csv). The template contains only headers, not real Plan values.

| Columns | Content |
|---|---|
| `SnapshotId`, `ScenarioName`, `PlanVersion`, `SourceWritebackRunIds` | One selected Snapshot and traceability for the selected Scenario / Plan state / source writeback runs |
| `ProductKey`, `Category`, `SubCategory` | Stable product key and classification from the original model |
| `PeriodKey`, `PeriodStart`, `PlanPeriodStatus` | `YYYY-MM`, first day of the month, and `ClosedLinkedActual` or `OpenSampleReference` |
| `CurrencyCode` | `USD` in this exercise |
| `ModelMeasureName`, `ModelGrossRevenue` | `Gross Revenue` and its value for the same Product / month |
| `PlanMeasureName`, `PlanForecast` | `Forecast` and its value for the same Product / month / Scenario |

Each row must be unique by `SnapshotId × ScenarioName × PlanVersion × ProductKey × PeriodKey`. Preserve amount precision in the CSV. Use `decimal(28,10)` in the Warehouse and, to match the verification, `DOUBLE` for Lakehouse columns used by Ontology / Graph. Graph values use floating-point representation, so use Warehouse Decimal values as the reference for exact amounts and independent numerical verification.

- **Closed period:** A month in which Forecast is linked to the actuals measure in the selected Plan state. Check the displayed Plan state and target Snapshot.
- **Open period:** A month comparing the Plan forecast with sample model values. Do not call model values finalized actuals.
- If denominator `ModelGrossRevenue` is 0, `VarianceRate` is NULL. Do not replace NULL with 0.
- Do not sum Long with Changes history or select current values using only `TOP 1` or the maximum timestamp. If a complete current state cannot be demonstrated, stop at Part 1.

lab09-s011.title: 6.3 Check Stage Selection and Data Quality
lab09-s011.parent: 6. Part 3A: Put the CSV in a Lakehouse and Reconcile in a Warehouse
lab09-s011.markdown:
The following values are recorded in the synthetic CSV: `SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'`, `ScenarioName = 'Base'`, and `PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'`. On a real-Plan route, replace them with your verified values. ExpectedRows must be a **positive value independently recorded** from the source comparison.

```sql
SELECT
    CAST('18' AS bigint) AS ExpectedRows,
    CASE WHEN CAST('18' AS bigint) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS InvalidExpectedRows,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS AllStageRows,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
                       AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
                       AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'
                      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SelectedRows
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage;

SELECT ProductKey, PeriodKey, COUNT_BIG(*) AS DuplicateRows
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
  AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
  AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'
GROUP BY ProductKey, PeriodKey
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) <> 1;

SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS InvalidSelectedRows
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
  AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
  AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'
  AND (
      NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SnapshotId)), '') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ScenarioName)), '') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(PlanVersion)), '') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SourceWritebackRunIds)), '') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ProductKey)), '') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(Category)), '') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SubCategory)), '') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(PeriodKey)), '') IS NULL
      OR PeriodKey NOT LIKE '[12][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]'
      OR RIGHT(PeriodKey, 2) NOT BETWEEN '01' AND '12'
      OR PeriodStart IS NULL
      OR PeriodKey <> CONVERT(char(7), PeriodStart, 126)
      OR DAY(PeriodStart) <> 1
      OR PlanPeriodStatus IS NULL
      OR PlanPeriodStatus NOT IN ('ClosedLinkedActual', 'OpenSampleReference')
      OR CurrencyCode IS NULL OR CurrencyCode <> 'USD'
      OR ModelMeasureName IS NULL OR ModelMeasureName <> 'Gross Revenue'
      OR PlanMeasureName IS NULL OR PlanMeasureName <> 'Forecast'
      OR ModelGrossRevenue IS NULL OR PlanForecast IS NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS WrongSelectedRows
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
WHERE SnapshotId <> 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
   OR ScenarioName <> 'Base'
   OR PlanVersion <> 'FY26-Workshop-v1';

SELECT ProductKey, COUNT_BIG(*) AS ConflictingProductRows
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ProductKey, Category, SubCategory
    FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
    WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
      AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
      AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'
) AS ProductRows
GROUP BY ProductKey
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) <> 1;

SELECT PeriodKey, COUNT_BIG(*) AS ConflictingPeriodRows
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT PeriodKey, PeriodStart, PlanPeriodStatus
    FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
    WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
      AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
      AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'
) AS PeriodRows
GROUP BY PeriodKey
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) <> 1;
```

**Check rows for the selected Snapshot / Scenario / PlanVersion.**
![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 028)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/028-validation-q1q2-in-editor.png)
![Lab09 numerical verification result (capture 029)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/029-validation-q1-result.png)
![Lab09 successful execution result (capture 031)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/031-validation-q1q2-messages.png)
**Review the additional data-quality checks.**
![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 032)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/032-validation-q3-in-editor.png)
![Lab09 numerical verification result (capture 033)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/033-validation-q3-result.png)
![Lab09 successful execution result (capture 036)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/036-validation-q4q5-messages.png)


Continue only if `ExpectedRows > 0`, `InvalidExpectedRows = 0`, all Stage rows = selected rows = ExpectedRows, wrong-ID rows = 0, and duplicates / invalid rows / product dimension conflicts / period dimension conflicts are all 0. For a real-Plan route, also check the private record showing that all original keys match in the Full Outer comparison. An empty table does not pass merely because it appears to have zero failing rows.

Next, create the selected Snapshot's product / period dimensions and Observations in the Warehouse using new table names. Stop if same-named tables already exist. This SQL is for verification, not an Ontology binding destination.

```sql
CREATE TABLE dbo.Lab09Product AS
SELECT DISTINCT ProductKey, Category, SubCategory
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
  AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
  AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1';

CREATE TABLE dbo.Lab09Period AS
SELECT DISTINCT PeriodKey, PeriodStart, PlanPeriodStatus
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
  AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
  AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1';

CREATE TABLE dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation AS
SELECT
    CONCAT(SnapshotId, '|', ScenarioName, '|', PlanVersion, '|',
           ProductKey, '|', PeriodKey) AS ObservationKey,
    SnapshotId, ScenarioName, PlanVersion, SourceWritebackRunIds,
    ProductKey, PeriodKey, PlanPeriodStatus, CurrencyCode,
    ModelMeasureName, ModelGrossRevenue, PlanMeasureName, PlanForecast,
    CAST(PlanForecast - ModelGrossRevenue AS decimal(29, 10)) AS VarianceAmount,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ModelGrossRevenue = 0 THEN NULL
              ELSE (PlanForecast - ModelGrossRevenue)
                   / NULLIF(ModelGrossRevenue, 0)
         END AS decimal(38, 9)) AS VarianceRate
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
  AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
  AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1';
```

**Create the three Lakehouse tables.**
![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 037)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/037-ctas-in-editor.png)
![Lab09 creation or loading complete (capture 038)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/038-ctas-succeeded-messages.png)
**Check variance formulas and key integrity.**
![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 040)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/040-step9-checks-in-editor.png)
![Lab09 numerical verification result (capture 041)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/041-step9-checks-result.png)


The following SQL checks variance formulas, zero denominators / NULL rates, row counts, duplicates, missing / extra rows relative to Stage, and orphan Product / Period keys. All failure checks from `DuplicateKeys` through `OrphanPeriodKeys` must be 0; StageRows and ObservationRows must equal the same positive ExpectedRows.

```sql
SELECT 'DuplicateKeys' AS CheckName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS CheckValue
FROM (
    SELECT ObservationKey
    FROM dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation
    GROUP BY ObservationKey
    HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) <> 1
) AS D
UNION ALL
SELECT 'InvalidVarianceRows', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation
WHERE VarianceAmount IS NULL
   OR VarianceAmount <> CAST(
          CAST(PlanForecast AS decimal(28, 10))
          - CAST(ModelGrossRevenue AS decimal(28, 10))
          AS decimal(29, 10)
      )
   OR (ModelGrossRevenue = 0 AND VarianceRate IS NOT NULL)
   OR (ModelGrossRevenue <> 0 AND
       (VarianceRate IS NULL OR VarianceRate <> CAST(
           (CAST(PlanForecast AS decimal(28, 10))
            - CAST(ModelGrossRevenue AS decimal(28, 10)))
           / NULLIF(CAST(ModelGrossRevenue AS decimal(28, 10)), 0)
           AS decimal(38, 9)
       )))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'StageRows', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage
WHERE SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
  AND ScenarioName = 'Base'
  AND PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ObservationRows', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MissingObservations', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Lab09Stage AS S
WHERE S.SnapshotId = 'LAB09-SAMPLE-001'
  AND S.ScenarioName = 'Base'
  AND S.PlanVersion = 'FY26-Workshop-v1'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation AS O
      WHERE O.SnapshotId = S.SnapshotId
        AND O.ScenarioName = S.ScenarioName
        AND O.PlanVersion = S.PlanVersion
        AND O.ProductKey = S.ProductKey
        AND O.PeriodKey = S.PeriodKey
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ExtraObservations', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation AS O
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Lab09Stage AS S
    WHERE S.SnapshotId = O.SnapshotId
      AND S.ScenarioName = O.ScenarioName
      AND S.PlanVersion = O.PlanVersion
      AND S.ProductKey = O.ProductKey
      AND S.PeriodKey = O.PeriodKey
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OrphanProductKeys', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation AS O
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Lab09Product AS P WHERE P.ProductKey = O.ProductKey
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OrphanPeriodKeys', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Lab09RevenueObservation AS O
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Lab09Period AS P WHERE P.PeriodKey = O.PeriodKey
);
```

**Review aggregates and the zero-denominator result.**
![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 042)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/042-aggregates-in-editor.png)
![Lab09 numerical verification result (capture 043)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/043-aggregates-result.png)
![Lab09 numerical verification result (capture 044)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/044-march-rows-nuts-null.png)


Also confirm `ExpectedRows > 0`, `AllStageRows = SelectedRows = ExpectedRows`, and zero rows with nonselected IDs / NULL keys / empty strings / invalid periods / invalid statuses / differing currencies or Measures / inconsistent ProductKey or PeriodKey attributes. A real-Plan route additionally requires private records showing all original keys matched by Full Outer comparison. Do not use formula recalculation alone as evidence of correctness; independently verify the complete original key set and Snapshot values.

lab09-s012.title: 7. Part 3B: Create Delta Tables in the Lakehouse
lab09-s012.markdown:
The Warehouse is the precision-preserving verification layer. For Ontology / Graph / Data Agent, create managed Delta tables in the schema-enabled Lakehouse. During verification, a Warehouse-bound Ontology was marked `Ineligible / Unsupported Datasource` in Graph, and Data Agent returned a generic error. Switching to Lakehouse Delta succeeded, but multiple changes were made together, so which condition was independently necessary has not been isolated.

1. Open `HPC_Lab09_Staging` and select **Analyze data with → New Spark SQL query**. Click the query editor before typing. The first Run may take time to start a Spark session.

   ![Lab09 operation screen (capture 179)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/179-lakehouse-analyze-data-with-menu.png)
   ![Lab09 operation screen (capture 180)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/180-lakehouse-new-spark-sql-query-editor.png)

2. Enter only the following statement in the query tab and Run it. Use `CREATE OR REPLACE` only after confirming that the table does not exist in a dedicated new Lakehouse, as in this verification. If a table already exists, stop without running.

   ```sql
   CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW lab09_stage USING csv OPTIONS (path 'Files/Lab09/run-sample001/lab09-variance-snapshot-sample.csv', header 'true');
   ```

3. Execute **only one Spark SQL statement per Run**. Including multiple statements in one Run causes `PARSE_SYNTAX_ERROR`. The temp view is temporary within the Spark session. If the session ends, rerun this statement first.

   **Failure from running multiple statements together.**
   ![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 181)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/181-lakehouse-spark-sql-script-typed.png)
   ![Lab09 failure or limitation message (capture 183)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/183-lakehouse-spark-sql-multi-statement-parse-error.png)
   **Create the Temp view.**
   ![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 184)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/184-spark-tempview-typed.png)
   ![Lab09 creation or loading complete (capture 185)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/185-spark-tempview-succeeded.png)

4. Execute each SQL statement below in a separate query tab or Run. If any of these fixed table names already exists, stop rather than overwrite it. During verification, each statement was executed once against dedicated new tables.

   ```sql
   CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dbo.lab09_product USING DELTA AS
   SELECT DISTINCT ProductKey, Category, SubCategory
   FROM lab09_stage;
   ```

   ```sql
   CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dbo.lab09_period USING DELTA AS
   SELECT DISTINCT PeriodKey, CAST(PeriodStart AS DATE) AS PeriodStart, PlanPeriodStatus
   FROM lab09_stage;
   ```

   ```sql
   CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dbo.lab09_revenue_observation USING DELTA AS
   SELECT
       concat_ws('|', SnapshotId, ScenarioName, PlanVersion, ProductKey, PeriodKey) AS ObservationKey,
       SnapshotId, ScenarioName, PlanVersion, SourceWritebackRunIds,
       ProductKey, PeriodKey, PlanPeriodStatus, CurrencyCode, ModelMeasureName,
       CAST(ModelGrossRevenue AS DOUBLE) AS ModelGrossRevenue,
       PlanMeasureName,
       CAST(PlanForecast AS DOUBLE) AS PlanForecast,
       CAST(PlanForecast AS DOUBLE) - CAST(ModelGrossRevenue AS DOUBLE) AS VarianceAmount,
       (CAST(PlanForecast AS DOUBLE) - CAST(ModelGrossRevenue AS DOUBLE))
           / NULLIF(CAST(ModelGrossRevenue AS DOUBLE), 0) AS VarianceRate
   FROM lab09_stage;
   ```

   **Create the Product Delta table.**
   ![Lab09 SQL entered for execution (capture 187)](../assets/screenshots/lab09/187-spark-product-ctas-typed.png)

lab09-s021.title: 9.2 Configure Instructions
lab09-s021.parent: 9. Part 5: Create a Data Agent and Ask Questions
lab09-s021.markdown:
The Japanese Instructions entered into `_LH2` during verification contained 17 lines / 856 characters. The block below is their English translation; enter its contents exactly. After editing, click outside the text to return to the preview. The English wording is a translation, not the verbatim text used in that verification.



```text
This Agent is a read-only analysis Agent using only HPC_Lab09_VarianceOntology_LH.
Normally, identify SnapshotId, ScenarioName, PlanVersion, one PeriodKey, and CurrencyCode
before answering. Only when multiple months are explicitly requested,
check the complete specified PeriodKey list and show row counts and amount totals separately
by PeriodKey and PlanPeriodStatus. Do not mix unknown or unrequested periods or another Snapshot /
Scenario / PlanVersion. If the scope is ambiguous, ask before answering.
VarianceAmount is PlanForecast - ModelGrossRevenue.
Do not sum or take a simple average of VarianceRate across multiple rows.
When an aggregate rate across multiple rows is requested, use
(SUM(PlanForecast) - SUM(ModelGrossRevenue)) / NULLIF(SUM(ModelGrossRevenue), 0)
and show the SnapshotId, ScenarioName, PlanVersion, and PeriodKey used to filter the answer so the user can compare it with Warehouse SQL results for the same key scope.
Do not calculate VarianceRate when ModelGrossRevenue is 0.
OpenSampleReference is a sample comparison value; do not call it finalized actuals.
Explicitly identify Closed period and Open period, and state the SnapshotId and conditions used.
With insufficient data, duplicates, multiple candidates, or unbound relationships, defer the answer rather than guess.
Do not claim to have performed root-cause analysis, future forecasting, recommendations, or Plan changes.
Support group by in GQL
```

lab09-s023.title: 10. Common Problems and Responses
lab09-s023.markdown:
| Display / symptom | Response |
|---|---|
| `COPY INTO` with Workspace Identity returns Msg 13840 | During verification, retrieving Workspace Identity credentials failed. Use the Entra passthrough route without CREDENTIAL. Do not change Identity settings without authorization |
| Spark SQL `PARSE_SYNTAX_ERROR` | Multiple statements are included in one Run. Run one statement at a time in a new Query |
| `Unsupported Datasource` with a Warehouse-bound Ontology | Retain the Warehouse for SQL verification and use managed Lakehouse Delta tables as the Ontology's Graph sources |
| Agent says `There's content here I can't work with` | Check Source Graph eligibility / materialization, Ontology bindings, and Data Agent Source. The Warehouse-bound failure was observed, but do not assert a universal cause |
| Instances tab says `doesn't have a table named` | Check Spark-side dbo table existence and bindings separately, wait a while, and reload. Do not use the Instances tab error as the sole success / failure criterion |
| Direct relationship reports `No Datasource` | Turn Use mapping table On in Relationship details. Check the Lakehouse Revenue Observation table and Origin / ObservationKey mappings |
| Relationship selection is disabled | Select both endpoint entities in Graph projection first, then check each relationship type individually |
| Done remains disabled after Materialize | Do not rerun Done; return Home and recheck Graph status |
| First Graph query Run is slow | It may take several minutes. Wait and check status rather than rerunning immediately |
| Only one entity type appears in the Agent | Complete / materialize the Ontology before adding it to the Agent. Refresh in `_LH` did not update its entity type list. All 3 types were confirmed in `_LH2`, created after completion |
| `SQLCandidatesFailedFilterError` | Reproduced in Q4 / Q4a. Try asking only for totals by period, as in Q4c, and verify in the Warehouse every time. Success is not guaranteed |

lab09-s024.title: 11. Finish Safely
lab09-s024.markdown: The CSV, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Ontology, and Data Agent are new assets dedicated to this exercise. When finished, the administrator and owners must review each target name, users, retention / audit requirements, and billing impact. Do not delete assets, change permissions, or change Workspace Identity without separate explicit approval. Do not use deletion of an entire existing Workspace or updates to shared Forecasts / original models as cleanup. Data Agent Publish / Share was not part of this verification; do not publish it.
